sections.title: The Discovery
key_events: Lena arrives at the excavation site after a gruelling trek through the jungle
She discovers a hidden chamber beneath the main temple
The first tablet is found, covered in symbols no one has seen before
Sok Chandra recognises the script and grows visibly unsettled
sections.transition_to: Lena begins decoding the first tablet overnight

sections.title: The Translations
key_events: Lena decodes the first tablet: it describes a flood that matches a historical event from 1287
She finds more tablets, each predicting events that have already occurred
Marcus Webb arrives uninvited and offers to collaborate
The penultimate tablet describes an event that has not yet happened
Tension between Lena and Marcus over how to handle the discovery
sections.transition_from: Lena's overnight work yields the first breakthrough
sections.transition_to: Lena steels herself to decode the final tablet

sections.title: The Final Tablet
key_events: The final tablet describes a collapse of the temple — and a woman who dies beneath the stones
Marcus attempts to steal the tablets for a private collector
Lena must choose: preserve the tablets or destroy them to prevent the prophecy
Sok Chandra reveals an alternative reading of the final inscription
Lena makes her choice, and the temple begins to shake
sections.transition_from: Lena confronts the final tablet alone at dawn
